cues.text: Hi. Can I help you?
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: I’d like to find out if you have any excursions suitable for families.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Sure. How about taking your family for a cruise? We have a steamship that takes passengers out several times a day – it’s over 100 years old.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: That sounds interesting. How long is the trip?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: About an hour and a half. And don’t forget to take pictures of the mountains. They’re all around you when you’re on the boat and they look fantastic.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: OK. And I assume there’s a café or something on board?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Sure. How old are your children?
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Er, my daughter’s fifteen and my son’s seven.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Right. Well there are various things you can do once you’ve crossed the lake, to make a day of it. One thing that’s very popular is a visit to the Country Farm. You’re met off the boat by the farmer and he’ll take you to the holding pens, where the sheep are kept. Children love feeding them!
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: My son would love that. He really likes animals.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Well, there’s also a 40-minute trek round the farm on a horse, if he wants.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Do you think he’d manage it? He hasn’t done that before.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Sure. It’s suitable for complete beginners.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Ah, good.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: And again, visitors are welcome to explore the farm on their own, as long as they take care to close gates and so on. There are some very beautiful gardens along the side of the lake which also belong to the farm – they’ll be just at their best now. You could easily spend an hour or two there.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: OK. Well that all sounds good. And can we get lunch there?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: You can, and it’s very good, though it’s not included in the basic cost. You pay when you get there.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Right.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: So is there anything else to do over on that side of the lake?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Well, what you can do is take a bike over on the ship and then go on a cycling trip. There’s a trail there called the Back Road – you could easily spend three or four hours exploring it, and the scenery’s wonderful. They’ll give you a map when you get your ticket for the cruise – there’s no extra charge.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: What’s the trail like in terms of difficulty?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Quite challenging in places. It wouldn’t be suitable for your seven-year-old. It needs someone who’s got a bit more experience.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Hmm. Well, my daughter loves cycling and so do I, so maybe the two of us could go, and my wife and son could stay on the farm. That might work out quite well. But we don’t have bikes here… is there somewhere we could rent them?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Yes, there’s a place here in the city. It’s called Ratchesons.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: I’ll just make a note of that – er, how do you spell it?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: R-A-T-C-H-E-S-O-N-S. It’s just be the cruise ship terminal.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: OK.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: You’d also need to pick up a repair kit for the bike from there to take along with you, and you’d need to take along a snack and some water – it’d be best to get those in the city.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Fine. That shouldn’t be a problem. And I assume I can rent a helmet from the bike place?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Sure, you should definitely get that. It’s a great ride, but you want to be well prepared because it’s very remote – you won’t see any shops round there, or anywhere to stay, so you need to get back in time for the last boat.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Yeah. So what sort of prices are we looking at here?
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Let’s see, that’d be one adult and one child for the cruise with farm tour, that’s $117, and an adult and a child for the cruise only so that’s $214 dollars altogether. Oh, wait a minute, how old did you say your daughter was?
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: Fifteen.
cues.speaker: VISITOR

cues.text: Then I’m afraid it’s $267 because she has to pay the adult fare, which is $75 instead of the child fare which is $22 – sorry about that.
cues.speaker: TC EMPLOYEE

cues.text: That’s OK. Er, so how do …
cues.speaker: VISITOR
